title: YouTube Video Redirect Service
subtitle: YouTube Video Link Handler
description: A small Flask app that uses yt-dlp to find a YouTube video’s direct media link and play it. For a shared song queue and OBS, see Streaming Player.
longDescription: A Flask service that accepts a video ID, resolves a direct media URL with yt-dlp and renders a player. The final version includes Docker and a JavaScript runtime for extraction. New song-request and OBS work continues in Streaming Player.
features: Direct media URL resolution with yt-dlp
results: Runnable final version preserved with tests and Docker
